summary: Genuine coverage: AnalyticsService.track() is the sole choke point (all 7 event-contract call sites funnel through it, no bypass), tests toggle the real setEnabled/analyticsEnabled path and assert no growth in the recorded-event list across app_opened, chat_started, settings_opened, right_pane_opened, prompt_submitted, pi_load_failed, and handled_exception, plus resumed reporting on re-enable; mock only stands in for the network-facing capture() call, not the enable/disable gate, so removing the guard would fail these assertions.
